dataNotes: SUPERSEDES the UNVERIFIED demo row 'Santa Cruz Hightower CC (2024)' - that row's geometry was invented placeholder data and must be discarded, not merged. Sourced from Santa Cruz's own model-year-specific support page, which states its coverage as '2023 - 2024', closing the model-year trap: this is GEN 3, not the gen-4 MY25/26/27 redesign. Gen 4 differs materially (230x57.5 shock, 36t max chainring, ISCG05, UDH, 220mm max rotor) - anyone re-sourcing from the default product page would import gen-4 specs onto a 2024 bike. STATED: material ('CARBON C/CC'; 'Material | Carbon Fiber'); BB ('Bottom Bracket Shell | 73mm Threaded'; '73mm - Threaded - ISO'); rear axle ('Rear Hub | 148x12mm Through Axle', corroborated by the MY24 build spec '12x148'); headset ('Tapered - Integrated. 1-1/8" Upper and 1.5" Lower. S.H.I.S. IS 41/28.6 IS 52/40'); brake ('Rear Brake Mount | 180 PM'); max rotor ('Max Brake Rotor Size | 203mm'); wheel ('WHEEL SIZE 29'); max tyre ('Max Tire Clearance | 2.5"' = 63.5mm, recorded 63); fork ('Fork Compatibility | 150-160mm', upper bound); max chainring ('34t' - note gen 4 is 36t); seatpost 31.6mm; bottles 1; shock ('Shock Length | 210mm', 'Shock Stroke | 55mm', corroborated on the base page). DERIVED: dropoutType from 'Through Axle'; shockMountType STANDARD_EYELET from 'Shock Bushing Size Front | 30x8' and 'Rear | 30x8 (bearing compatible)' - a bushing at BOTH ends with a stated eye-to-eye means eyelet; no trunnion wording appears anywhere. LEFT NULL: hangerStandard - UDH is NOT claimed for gen 3, only for gen 4, so deliberately null rather than inherited; iscgStandard; chainstayLengthMm (Santa Cruz publish per-size rear centre only).

Hardtail. Model-year scope STATED as '2023 - 2024'. Alloy only - grouped separately from any carbon Chameleon per the material/mould rule. CONFIDENCE MEDIUM because of an internal conflict at Santa Cruz on the required brake field: the MY24 page states 'Rear Brake Mount | Post Mount 180', while the gen-8 base page's older-format table has a generic row 'Brakes | Disc Brake - ISO'. Took the dedicated, correctly-labelled, model-year-specific field (Post Mount 180) and FLAGGED THE DISCREPANCY FOR HUMAN REVIEW rather than silently averaging them. STATED: material ('Aluminum - 6000 series'); BB ('73mm Threaded'; '73mm - Threaded - ISO'); rear axle ('Rear Hub | 148x12mm Through Axle'); headset ('Tapered - Integrated ... IS 41/28.6 IS 52/40'); wheel ('Wheel Size | 29'); max tyre ('Max Tire Clearance | 29"x2.6" | 27.5"x2.8"' - 2.6in = 66.04 recorded as 66 for the 29in configuration this row describes); fork ('Fork Compatibility | 130mm - 140mm', upper bound); max chainring 34t; seatpost 31.6mm; bottles 2; ISCG-05. DERIVED: dropoutType from 'Through Axle' - note Santa Cruz also describe interchangeable dropouts, but no spacing other than 148x12 is stated. LEFT NULL: maxRotorMmRear (no max-rotor row on the MY24 table, omitted entirely from the base page); hangerStandard (not stated - specifically NOT recorded as UDH); chainstayLengthMm (sliding dropouts give a range Santa Cruz do not publish); all shock fields (hardtail). mulletApproved and hasEyelets omitted: the 27.5x2.8 clearance figure shows the frame accepts a 27.5 rear, but Santa Cruz nowhere state a 29-front/27.5-rear mullet approval, and 'eyelets' is ambiguous for a hardtail - abstained on both.

From Cannondale's own Habit FS/HT Owner's Manual Supplement (doc 152197 Rev 0, 11/22), which Cannondale's manual index labels 'Habit (2023)' - that index heading is the source of the model year. MODEL-YEAR TRAP CLOSED: an older Habit supplement is still live and describes a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT frame (120mm rear, 142x12 dropout, BB30 alloy / PF30 carbon, FLAT-mount rear brake, direct-mount front derailleur). That document was rejected. Generation confirmed by matching the live Habit 3 frame description word-for-word to this manual. ALLOY-vs-CARBON: the manual's table carries separate Carbon and Alloy columns; this row uses the ALLOY column only. STATED: material ('SmartForm C1 Alloy'); BB ('BSA/73mm'); rear axle ('Maxle UDH TA/148mm x 12mm x 1.0P/Overall Length 180mm'); dropout (UDH); headset ('UPR: 1-1/8", LWR: 1-1/2"'); brake ('Rear Brake: Mount Type / Min./Max. Rotor Dia.' = 'Post Mount/180mm/203mm'); wheel + max tyre (alloy column '29" x 2.6"' = 66.04, recorded 66); seatpost ('31.6mm/34.9mm' = post/binder); ISCG 05; hanger ('SRAM Universal Derailleur Hanger'); shock ('Habit 210x47.5' - the manual gives Habit and Habit LT separately, so this value is unambiguous for the 130mm Habit). LEFT NULL: shockMountType - the manual gives bushings as 'FT: M8 x 20mm RR: None', which does not establish trunnion vs standard eyelet; maxForkTravelMm (only the fitted 140mm fork is listed, a build spec not a frame limit); maxChainringTeeth, chainstayLengthMm (size-specific under Proportional Response), bottleMounts. MINOR DISCREPANCY: the product page lists wheel size as '29, 27.5 (XS)' whereas the manual's alloy column gives 29in flat; UK sales are MD/LG only, so ISO_622 is correct for this market - flag if XS is ever stocked.

Filed as a SEPARATE ROW from the 130mm Habit deliberately. Cannondale's manual gives one spec table but TWO explicitly named shock specs - 'Habit 210x47.5, Habit LT 210x55'. R-SHK-01 requires eye-to-eye AND stroke to match exactly with no tolerance, so collapsing both into one row would have made one of the two values wrong and silently excluded a legal shock. Because the two strokes map cleanly onto two manufacturer-named models, splitting preserves exactness. These two rows may well share a mould; treat them as one mould with two sanctioned shock fitments, not two independent frames. Model year 2023 from Cannondale's manual index heading 'Habit (2023)'. Generation confirmed by the live Habit LT 2 frame description matching the manual. ALLOY column used throughout. STATED: material ('SmartForm C1 Alloy'); rear travel 140mm; shock ('Habit LT 210x55'); all remaining fields STATED in the shared manual table exactly as itemised in the 130mm Habit row - BB 'BSA/73mm', axle 'Maxle UDH TA/148mm x 12mm x 1.0P', headset 'UPR: 1-1/8", LWR: 1-1/2"', brake 'Post Mount/180mm/203mm', tyre '29" x 2.6"' -> 66, seatpost 31.6mm, ISCG 05, SRAM UDH. LEFT NULL for the same reasons as the Habit row: shockMountType ('FT: M8 x 20mm RR: None' is not conclusive), maxForkTravelMm (only the fitted 150mm fork appears), maxChainringTeeth, chainstayLengthMm, bottleMounts.

Hardtail. From Cannondale's Scalpel HT Owner's Manual Supplement (doc 138678 Rev 1, 09/21), indexed by Cannondale as 'Scalpel HT (2021)'. MODEL-YEAR TRAP CHECKED AND CLEARED - not assumed: the current Scalpel HT Carbon 3 frame line reads 'Scalpel HT Carbon, Proportional Response Design, PF30-83, tapered head tube, 55mm chainline, Speed Release 12mm thru axle w/UDH hanger', which matches the 2021 manual's BB and axle standards exactly, so the platform is unchanged and the manual applies. NOTE the OPPOSITE finding for the full-suspension Scalpel, which HAS changed generation (moved to 73mm BSA) and is deliberately excluded from this dataset. STATED: material (frame named 'Scalpel HT Carbon'); BB ('Bottom Bracket: Type/Width | 83mm PF30'; product page 'PF30-83') - recorded as PF30 with an explicit 83mm width, since the enum has no PF30-83 member and the width carries the Ai-era asymmetry; rear axle ('Speed Release UDH/148x12x1.0P', overall length 173.5mm); dropout (UDH); headset ('Head Tube | UPR: 1 1/8in LWR: 1 1/2in', 'Headset | Integrated 1 1/8in-1.5in'); brake ('Post Mount/160/180mm' = 160 native, 180 max); wheel + max tyre ('29 x 2.35in' = 59.69mm, recorded 59 using the same downward rounding); seatpost ('27.2mm/30.9mm' = post/binder) - NOTE 27.2mm, not the 31.6mm common elsewhere in this dataset; hanger ('SRAM UDH'). LEFT NULL: iscgStandard - the manual's chain guide row reads 'K11271 only', a proprietary Cannondale part that maps to no ISCG value, so abstained rather than guessing ISCG_05 or NONE; maxForkTravelMm - the manual publishes only a maximum fork LENGTH (530mm), which is not a travel figure and must not be converted into one; maxChainringTeeth, chainstayLengthMm, bottleMounts.
